source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a study of 48 NF1 patients evaluated at a hypertension clinic, 15% harbored a pheochromocytoma and 57% of those were symptomatic at diagnosis.
